title: Jagged Crispy Thai Deodeok Root Som Tum
description: A citrusy and crispy Northern Thai dish featuring deodeok root, infused oil, and ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, perfect for a date night, this som tum recipe is a unique twist on traditional Thai cuisine.
instructions: Heat the infused oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the grated deodeok root and cook until it is slightly caramelized and crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked deodeok root, lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, and salt, and mix well.
Stir in the toasted and crushed crispy rice, chopped roasted peanuts, and chopped fresh cilantro.
Add the sliced Thai chilies and mix gently.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the som tum a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the jagged crispy Thai deodeok root som tum chilled, garnished with additional chopped cilantro and peanuts if desired.
